summary: The detector improved materially after adding IPv4/IPv6, date, UPI, JWT, and basic name/address coverage, but the corpus still exposes weak handling for OCR noise, line-broken secrets, and some AWS secret edge cases.
notes: The summarizer uses section-based rules to decide whether a case should have been redacted.
That makes the report useful for review, but it is still a heuristic and not a perfect ground-truth judge for every section.
recommended_next_fix: Tighten the section-to-ground-truth mapping so OCR-noise and broken-input sections are treated conservatively.
Add explicit heuristics for spaced OCR tokens, line-broken secrets, and shorter AWS-key-like fragments.
Keep a small false-positive guard for UUIDs, invoice/order IDs, and random hex strings.
